claim_ceiling: Generated navigation over the sealed self-contract; not law, independent review, or proof by self-reference.

guarantees.title: Evidence classes are not silently promoted
Plans and explanations grant no authority
Proof, examples, and headless execution retain their boundary
The workbench exposes its own bounded contract

nonclaims.statement: MIW does not prove that a human-authored requirement is the right requirement.
MIW does not prove arbitrary C++ or an arbitrary Zucchini codebase correct.
MIW does not prove that database inventory equals physical inventory in a warehouse.
MIW cannot guarantee an invariant while uncontrolled write paths bypass the governed operation.
No MIW receipt, plan, diagnostic, or explanation grants production authority.
Builder-authored courts and tests are not independent review or certification.
Headless and mocked process tests do not prove native Windows appearance or the absence of visible console flash.
The self-contract does not recursively prove MIW or eliminate its trusted base.
Equal hashes establish byte identity, not semantic correctness; unequal hashes do not by themselves establish semantic difference.
Reference-model and fixture success do not establish live PostgreSQL behavior unless the explicit live lane ran.

trusted_assumptions.statement: The identified Python interpreter executes the checked MIW code according to its documented semantics.
The named operating system and filesystem return the bytes MIW reads and durably preserve accepted writes.
The canonical JSON and SHA-256 implementation bind records as specified.
The restricted source translator and native proof checker correctly implement their declared logic.
The archive hash and closed manifest are checked by a trustworthy external mechanism at the transfer boundary.
Authorized humans review business meaning, mappings, waivers, and institutional policy.
A privileged adversary does not replace code, inputs, or outputs between validation and use.
